power:
强化普攻、重击与剑气。
派生伤害不会重复放大。

Strengthens primary, heavy and wave attacks.
Derived hits are not amplified twice.
agility:
提升普通移动速度。
不改变闪避速度。

Move faster between attacks.
Dodge speed is unchanged.
wave:
普攻挥空也会发出剑气。
命中目标或墙体后消失。

Primary attacks launch a wave even on a miss.
It ends on contact with a target or wall.
chain:
命中后跳向附近敌人。
每跳保留 {falloff_percent}% 伤害。

Hits jump to nearby foes.
Each jump retains {falloff_percent}% damage.
split:
投射物接敌后分裂。
子体造成 {damage_percent}% 伤害。

Projectiles split on enemy contact.
Children deal {damage_percent}% damage.
impact_blast:
接敌触发衰减范围爆炸。
直击目标不重复承受爆炸。

Contact creates a falling-off area blast.
The direct target is not hit twice.
contact_slow:
命中施加减速，持续 {duration_sec} 秒。
重复命中保留较长剩余时间。

Hits slow for {duration_sec} s.
Reapplying retains the longer time.
contact_freeze:
直接接触的敌人被冻住。
解冻后获得短暂抗冻。

Directly contacted foes freeze.
Thawing grants brief freeze resistance.
freeze_duration:
延长这个动作施加的冻结。
需要同一动作具备冻结能力。

Extends this action's freezes.
This action must already be able to freeze.
pierce:
直线剑气连续穿过敌人。
与同动作的分裂互斥。

Linear waves pass through several foes.
Exclusive with Split on the same action.
frost_blast:
兼容爆炸对范围内敌人施加冻结。
需要命中爆炸。

Compatible blasts freeze nearby foes.
Requires Impact Blast.
action_power:
强化绑定动作的攻击伤害。
与全局增伤共同生效。

Strengthens the bound action.
Combines with global damage bonuses.
shatter_followup:
追击较早一次剑气建立的冻结窗口。
同一发剑气不能触发自身追击。

Punish a frost window from an earlier wave.
A wave cannot enable its own follow-up.
opening_strike:
普攻追击另一动作建立的冻结窗口。
强化直击，不消耗冻结。

Primary punishes a frost window from another action.
Boosts direct hits without consuming freeze.
returning_wave:
剑气到达射程或命中后折返。
回程可再次命中，墙体仍会阻挡。

Waves return after reaching range or hitting.
The return can hit again; walls still block it.
charged_wave:
按住右键 {threshold_sec} 秒后松开。
蓄满释放宽阔月牙，冷却 ×{cooldown_ratio}。

Hold RMB for {threshold_sec} s, then release.
A charged wide crescent has ×{cooldown_ratio} cooldown.
shatter_heavy:
重击消费已有的冻结窗口。
强化这次打击，随后进入抗冻。

Heavy attacks consume a prior frost window.
The stronger hit is followed by freeze resistance.
frost_path:
需要剑气具备冻结能力。
沿途留下减速霜径，不冻结敌人。

Requires a wave capable of freezing.
Leaves a slowing trail; the trail never freezes.
ice_coat:
剑气成功建立冻结窗口时获得护盾。
持续 {duration_sec} 秒，触发间隔 {trigger_cooldown_sec} 秒。

Gain a shield when a wave creates a frost window.
Lasts {duration_sec} s; triggers every {trigger_cooldown_sec} s.
fire_core:
命中附加 {stacks_per_hit} 层灼烧。
持续造成火焰伤害。

Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} burn stack(s).
Burn deals damage over time.
ice_core:
命中附加 {stacks_per_hit} 层冰寒。
满层冻结；Boss 改为强减速。

Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} chill stack(s).
Full stacks freeze, or strongly slow bosses.
thunder_core:
命中附加感电。
再次命中时，电弧伤及附近敌人。

Hits apply shock.
The next hit discharges into nearby foes.
earth_core:
命中附加 {stacks_per_hit} 层碎甲。
提高承受伤害，更快打破霸体。

Hits apply {stacks_per_hit} fracture stack(s).
Foes take more damage and lose guard faster.
fire_kindling:
提高每层灼烧的持续伤害。
让留下的余烬继续灼痛敌人。

Each burn stack deals more damage over time.
Embers keep hurting foes.
fire_blaze:
提高灼烧可叠加的层数。
连续命中积累更猛烈的火势。

Raises the burn stack limit.
Repeated hits build a stronger blaze.
fire_linger:
延长灼烧的持续时间。
离开近战范围后仍能造成伤害。

Burn remains active longer.
Damage continues after you move away.
ice_deep:
更少的冰寒层数即可冻结。
更快建立控制窗口。

Fewer chill stacks are needed to freeze.
Create frost windows sooner.
ice_lasting:
延长冰寒状态的持续时间。
减速与叠层更容易衔接。

Chill lasts longer.
Keep the slow and build stacks more easily.
ice_brittle:
冰寒每层提供额外易伤。
趁寒意尚在持续进攻。

Every chill stack adds vulnerability.
Press the attack while chill lasts.
thunder_chain:
感电放电波及更多敌人。
适合应对密集的敌群。

Discharge can reach more foes.
Useful against clustered enemies.
thunder_surge:
提高感电放电的伤害。
下一次命中引出更强电弧。

Increases shock discharge damage.
The next hit triggers stronger arcs.
thunder_reach:
扩大感电放电的传导距离。
连接站得更远的敌人。

Discharge arcs travel farther.
Connect enemies spread farther apart.
earth_crush:
每层碎甲提供额外易伤。
趁护甲破裂继续输出。

Every fracture stack adds vulnerability.
Exploit broken defenses.
earth_quake:
土元素命中造成额外破防。
更快击破重装敌人的霸体。

Earth hits deal extra guard damage.
Break armored foes' guard sooner.
earth_layers:
提高碎甲的最大叠层。
让易伤效果进一步累积。

Raises the fracture stack limit.
Build additional vulnerability.
dual_steam:
需要同时拥有火与冰。
强化两种元素交汇的蒸腾反应。

Requires both fire and ice.
Strengthens their steam reaction.
dual_overload:
需要同时拥有火与雷。
强化过载，范围 +{radius_bonus_m} 米。

Requires both fire and lightning.
Overload also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
dual_lava:
需要同时拥有火与土。
强化熔岩，范围 +{radius_bonus_m} 米。

Requires both fire and earth.
Lava also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
dual_superconduct:
需要同时拥有冰与雷。
强化超导，范围 +{radius_bonus_m} 米。

Requires both ice and lightning.
Superconduct gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
dual_shatter:
先建立冻结窗口，再以土命中。
强化碎冰，范围 +{radius_bonus_m} 米。

Freeze first, then strike with earth.
Shatter also gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
dual_magnet:
需要同时拥有雷与土。
强化磁暴，吸附范围 +{radius_bonus_m} 米。

Requires both lightning and earth.
Magnet pull gains {radius_bonus_m} m radius.
fire_mastery_burst:
需要两个按键带火。
灼烧叠满时引爆，并向周围传播。

Requires fire on two actions.
Full burn stacks explode and spread burn.
fire_mastery_heat:
需要两个按键带火。
进一步强化每层灼烧伤害。

Requires fire on two actions.
Further strengthens damage per burn stack.
ice_mastery_burst:
需要两个按键带冰。
冻住敌人时迸出冰片并传播冰寒。

Requires ice on two actions.
Freezing bursts into shards and spreads chill.
ice_mastery_cold:
需要两个按键带冰。
进一步强化冰寒带来的易伤。

Requires ice on two actions.
Further strengthens chill vulnerability.
thunder_mastery_burst:
需要两个按键带雷。
放电扩散伤害，并为周围敌人感电。

Requires lightning on two actions.
Discharge spreads damage and shock.
thunder_mastery_storm:
需要两个按键带雷。
进一步强化感电放电伤害。

Requires lightning on two actions.
Further strengthens discharge damage.
earth_mastery_burst:
需要两个按键带土。
碎甲叠满时地裂，并向周围传播碎甲。

Requires earth on two actions.
Full fracture stacks rupture and spread fracture.
earth_mastery_weight:
需要两个按键带土。
进一步强化碎甲带来的易伤。

Requires earth on two actions.
Further strengthens fracture vulnerability.
primary_reach:
扩大左键普攻的打击范围。
便于保持距离并追击敌人。

Extends the reach of primary attacks.
Keep your distance while striking.
special_reach:
扩大 R 键重击的打击范围。
宽阔横扫覆盖更多敌人。

Extends the reach of heavy attacks.
A wider sweep covers more enemies.
